subject: Comp package review and sign-off: Staff SWE (L5) — Sam Ortiz
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 20 Feb 2027 10:17:00 -0800
Subject: Comp proposal: Sam Ortiz (Staff SWE / L5) — request for sign-off

Hi Karthik, Laura,

Quick summary for Sam Ortiz (ex-Lead at BrightAI). Strong infra + latency optimization background — hiring manager recommends L5 (Staff SWE). He has another market offer with a higher cash component, so we want a competitive combination to close in this cycle.

Proposed package (v1 attached):
- Base: $210,000
- Target bonus: 12% (performance)
- Sign-on: $30,000 (one-time)
- Equity: 45,000 RSUs over 4 years (quarterly cliff schedule)
- Level: L5 (midband), comp band midpoint for L5 = $205k base (see comp-band-l5-2027.xlsx)

Context & ask:
- We think base slightly above midpoint is justified given specific infra experience and fast ramp expectations.
- Please confirm you approve the mix (base / sign-on / equity) and that we can consume HC-2027-45 for this slot. If approved, we'll create the offer in Greenhouse and route for e-sign.

Attachments: offer_sheet_sam_ortiz_v1.pdf, comp-band-l5-2027.xlsx

Thanks — planning to extend verbal if we have sign-off by Monday.

—Marissa
Marissa Cole | Senior Recruiter, Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com | (555) 413-9921

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 20 Feb 2027 13:40:12 -0800
Subject: Re: Comp proposal: Sam Ortiz (Staff SWE / L5) — request for sign-off

Marissa — thanks for the packet and context. A few quick thoughts: I think the base is fine but would prefer shifting some of the mix toward sign-on given his competing cash offer and the risk of a counter. Proposed adjustment:
- Base: $205,000 (back to midpoint)
- Sign-on: $40,000 (one-time)
- Equity: 40,000 RSUs over 4 years
- Bonus: keep 12% target

Rationale: leveling to midpoint keeps comp philosophy consistent; larger sign-on increases near-term cash competitiveness without pushing permanent OTE too far. If Laura (Finance/Comp) is comfortable with the sign-on delta, give me the greenlight and we will send the updated offer. Also confirm HC# and cost center: should be HC-2027-45 / Cost center 4102-ENG.

CC: Laura — requesting quick sanity check on budget impact.

—Karthik
Karthik Iyer | Eng Manager, Core Serving
karthik_iyer@redwood.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>

Date: Sun, 21 Feb 2027 09:05:37 -0800
Subject: Re: Comp proposal: Sam Ortiz (Staff SWE / L5) — updated offer attached

Thanks Karthik — updated offer attached (offer_sheet_sam_ortiz_v2.pdf).

Highlights (v2):
- Base: $205,000
- Sign-on: $40,000 (paid over first two payroll cycles)
- Equity: 40,000 RSUs (4y, 1y cliff / quarterly thereafter)
- Bonus: 12% target
- Notes: Relocation not applicable. Start date flexible: target Apr 4.

Requesting final approval from Finance/Comp (Laura) and headcount confirmation. Candidate has signaled urgency — if we can send a written offer Mon morning that'll help secure acceptance.

Attachments: offer_sheet_sam_ortiz_v2.pdf

Subject: Re: Comp proposal: Sam Ortiz (Staff SWE / L5) — approval (conditional)

Marissa, Karthik — reviewed v2 and comp-band reference. I ran a quick headcount/budget check with Finance and here are the notes: 

- Headcount: HC-2027-45 is available and authorized for Q2 hiring; approved owner is Eng Leadership.
- Cost center 4102-ENG has sufficient budget for FY27 to cover the proposed OTE (base + bonus + amortized equity run-rate).
- Sign-on: $40k sign-on is above our typical midpoint sign-on but acceptable for critical infra hires; please treat $40k as a one-off and document the business justification in the candidate file.

Formal decision: APPROVED to extend offer with the v2 structure. Conditions: add the 'one-off sign-on justification' note to Greenhouse, and route final offer to Legal for the standard clauses (IP, confidentiality, arbitration).

Please proceed. Confirm when offer is sent and share candidate's verbal acceptance or counter.

—Laura
